theme_central: Tripartite structure: reminder of Allah's power framing, at its center, examples of prophets who faced adversity — to console and warn the Prophet Muhammad.

branches.title: Opening, warning
branches.resume: Mockery of the disbelievers at the oneness proclaimed, astonishment that there is only one God.

children.t: Mockery of the disbelievers: "has he made the gods into one God?"

branches.title: Dawud, judgment and repentance
branches.resume: His strength in Allah's service, the parable of the two litigants, his repentance after a hasty judgment.

children.t: Dawud's strength, mountains and birds glorifying with him, wisdom of judgment
Parable of the two litigants and the ewes, Dawud's repentance
Refutation of creation in vain, the blessed Book for reflection

branches.title: Sulayman
branches.resume: His love of horses, his trial, the incomparable kingdom granted to him.

children.t: Sulayman: trial, wind and demons subdued, incomparable kingdom

branches.title: Ayyub, Ibrahim, Ishaq, Ya'qub
branches.resume: Ayyub's trial and patience, his healing; men of strength and vision among the prophets.

children.t: Ayyub's trial, his patience, healing, the oath kept with a bundle of twigs
Ibrahim, Ishaq, Ya'qub, Isma'il, al-Yasa, Dhul-Kifl: men of excellence

branches.title: Paradise and the fate of the transgressors
branches.resume: Description of Paradise for the pious, contrasted with the dispute of the people of the Fire.

children.t: Description of the Paradise promised to the pious
Fate of the transgressors, mutual dispute in Hell

branches.title: The Prophet, a warner
branches.resume: The Prophet is only a warner, no god but Allah the One, the Supreme Dominator.

children.t: The Prophet a warner, oneness of Allah reaffirmed

branches.title: Adam, Iblis, closing
branches.resume: Creation of Adam, Iblis's refusal to prostrate, his respite granted, closing on the Qur'an as a universal reminder.

children.t: Creation of Adam, command to prostrate, Iblis's arrogant refusal
Respite granted to Iblis, his promise to mislead men except the chosen ones
Closing: the Qur'an, a reminder for the whole universe
